in_sanskrit.name: इक्षाण्श
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of Vision, Lord of Sight
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ikshansh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ikshana’ which means ‘to see, to look at, to observe, or to perceive’. The suffix ‘sh’ is a common one in Indian names, indicating the presence of a deity or a divine being. Thus, the name Ikshansh can be interpreted as ‘Lord of Vision’ or ‘Lord of Sight’.
